title: The father of Android has reportedly cancelled his next big smartphone and might sell the company after raising $300 million (GOOG, AAPL)
text: The father of Android has reportedly cancelled his next big smartphone and might sell the company after raising $300 million (GOOG, AAPL) By Avery Hartmans May 24, 2018, 5:36 pm 20 pts Essential — the startup founded by Android creator Andy Rubin — plans to sell itself, according to a new Bloomberg report. The hardware company released its first product, the Essential Phone, last year. But plans have now been scrapped to release a second device. Essential has raised $300…
